# Finch · Gewohnheiten

- [Preis und Paywall](#theme-pricing_paywall)

## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 06.08.2026 - 12.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Darlingwhatever_, 12.09.2026, 1/5: "I didn’t pay to play through a movie trailer. I pay for the premium version of this app and enjoy using it for it’s intended purpose, I like the monthly supply of new content to dress my bird and decorate his home. Two months of the last year that content has been tie-ins to an upcoming movie. It feels greedy to push premium on people and then the benefits of their premiums subscription is being forced to learn about a movie they’re paying you to sell us. Supergirl and Forgotten Island collabs were a bad idea."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, 06.08.2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 10.09.2026 - 10.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _spudd122_, 10.09.2026, 4/5: "I’ve really loved this app for over 2 years now. It’s been helpful for building good habits and staying on top of self-care and mental health. However, the month long events turning into a month long advertisement for an upcoming movie every few months is getting annoying and old quick. I understand this app is free, but forcing month long ads on your customers shouldn’t be the way to pay for it. Ads annoy people and they’ll stop using your product to avoid them."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 28.05.2026 - 15.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Bebebebbebbbbbbbebeb_, 15.09.2026, 1/5: "charged 50$ without my knowledge. barely day 6 on my free trail. wouldn’t let me refund it. horrible. do not do the free trail it’s glitchy"
            2. _plantguyhome_, 28.05.2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            3. _Payton10101_, 15.09.2026, 5/5: "For the last few weeks, and this has been a reoccurring issue for months, I have been so dehydrated that I get dizzy spells, feel a bit faint, and eating a lot less (very unhealthy amounts). Finch is helping to remind me to drink water, even if it is just three cups a day. Anything is better than what it was. Finch is also helping me with my emotional regulation. I have always, always had an issue with my emotions. I cope with stress and anxiety and fear and anger by ignoring how bad the situation really is and rationalizing it. In turn, I do not let out my negative emotions. Because of this, I’ve had many times where my emotions became so strong that I basically imploded on myself and had a severe bout of depression. I eventually got better, but my coping habits never changed. A few years later in High school, I relapsed with another, smaller bout of depression. I had more people to rely on, but it doesn’t change the fact that I didn’t have an outlet for my emotions. However, Finch reminds me every day to write in a log how I felt that day. Although small, I know that nobody but me will ever see this and I can even look back at my logs."
<!--/ir-theme-->
